title: The Postcards of the family house on Kessler Street
author: Beatrix Sterling
blurb: Sable Amberdale, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
